mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.1%) compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuation and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 10% signals a weak labor market, prompting central bank policy easing and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 10.0%, or the Rank IC over 2 years is below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based demand contraction, triggering a flight to quality in equities and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST declines > 2% and RSAFS declines > 1% in the prior month
evidence_refs: fact:HOUST at 974.0 and RSAFS at 485545.0 in June 2020
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by >2% and >1% respectively, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a manufacturing supply shock (INDPRO below 95), the S&P 500 experiences negative returns over the next 20 trading days due to recessionary fears and reduced corporate earnings visibility.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is below 95, or the Rank IC over 2 years is below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level below 1000 thousand units signals weak residential construction, indicating a broader economic slowdown and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST is below 1000, or the Rank IC over 1 year is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A lower CPIAUCSL index level (indicating lower inflation) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as it reduces the likelihood of monetary tightening.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL is below 250, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a labor market recovery (PAYEMS above 130,000 thousand persons), the S&P 500 experiences positive returns over the next 20 trading days due to improved consumer spending and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS exceeds 130,000, or the Rank IC over 2 years is below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: A higher industrial production index (INDPRO above 100) indicates robust manufacturing activity, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is above 100, or the Rank IC over 1 year is below 0.03.
